label: Sales Proposal Writer
description: Write compelling sales proposals and RFP responses. Covers executive summaries, approach descriptions, team profiles, pricing presentations, and win themes. Tailored to the client's specific needs and decision criteria.

guidedInputs.label: Client information
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Nordea, largest Nordic bank, 28,000 employees, currently upgrading AML/CFT framework to comply with AMLR. MLRO is our main contact. They have been working with Deloitte but want fresh perspective.

guidedInputs.label: Proposed scope of work
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Phase 1: AMLR gap analysis (6 weeks), Phase 2: Remediation roadmap (2 weeks), Phase 3: Implementation support (6 months). Team: 1 partner, 2 seniors, 1 analyst.

guidedInputs.label: Our differentiators for this deal
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., We have done AMLR gap analysis for 15 Nordic banks already, our team includes former regulators, we have proprietary gap analysis methodology, we are faster and more practical than Big 4

guidedInputs.label: Known client concerns or priorities
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Tight deadline (must complete by Q3), budget constrained, previous consultant delivered academic report with no practical use, need people who understand their specific business

guidedInputs.label: Pricing information
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Fixed fee EUR 350,000 for Phase 1+2, T&M for Phase 3 at blended rate EUR 2,200/day, payment terms: monthly invoicing 30 days
